seniors.seated_version: Focus on rhythmic foot tapping and upper body sway.
seniors.standing_version: Supportive hold with a partner or chair, emphasizing the gliding step without weight-bearing jumps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to ensure balance and comfort.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Closed dance position with the lead's right arm around the follower's back.
movement_profile.footwork: Flat-footed glide with heel and toe touches; neither foot is lifted completely from the ground.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Not described in sources; emphasis is on ground-level gliding.
movement_profile.partnering: Lead-and-follow; the man establishes pace and stride length.

signature_moves.description: Gliding steps consistent with wearing cowboy boots.
signature_moves.name: Cowboy Waltz

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid 'toe type' dancing or lifting feet completely off the ground.

music_profile.sound_description: Music is characterized by fiddle-led melodies, often incorporating rhythmic elements like patting juba or percussive sounds from improvised instruments.

teaching.level_notes: Informal and varied; no single 'correct' set of steps.
teaching.rhythm: Varies by dance (e.g., Two Step, Waltz, Polka)
